scientific_integrity: The identity and class-size formulas are proven by linear algebra, conjugacy action and finite-group character induction; small-group enumeration is supporting evidence only. Priority risk is identified, and no independent confirmation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The class gap is unbounded as primes vary, not at a fixed prime. Invariant equality concerns exact conjugacy-class-size and irreducible-degree multiplicities plus all orientable surface-word fibers, not all group words or full character tables. A broader historical equivalence theorem may cover the result; the relevant Ito–Mann 2006 full text was inaccessible.
title: Joint class, character and surface-word blindness to nilpotency class in exponent-\(p\) groups
